metadata.name: heimdall
metadata.description: Bootstrap integration type for the Heimdall ecosystem guardian plugin.

guardian_name.description: Display name used by the ecosystem guardian.

observation_scope.description: Logical scope observed by the guardian.

critical_auto_remediation_enabled.description: Whether Heimdall should prepare auto-dispatchable remediation plans for critical incidents.

recommendation_limit.description: Maximum number of recommendations returned per execution.

default_owner_team.description: Default team escalated in remediation recommendations.

default_repository_owner.description: Default GitHub owner used when Heimdall synthesizes deploy workflow dispatches.

default_deploy_workflow.description: Workflow filename used when Heimdall suggests a redeploy action.

queue_backlog_threshold.description: Backlog threshold that turns a queue signal into an actionable finding.

error_rate_threshold.description: Error-rate threshold that marks a component as unhealthy.

secret_expiry_warning_hours.description: Warn when managed secrets expire within this many hours.

monthly_cost_budget_usd.description: Optional monthly cost budget used to flag budget pressure.

utilization_floor.description: Utilization floor below which a component is considered overprovisioned.

idle_environment_hours.description: Number of idle hours after which a component becomes a scale-down candidate.

max_rightsize_change_percent.description: Maximum bounded right-sizing step Heimdall should suggest in one action.

capacity_hotfix_profiles.description: Optional bounded CPU hotfix profiles matched by environment, namespace, workload name, or workload name prefix.

llm_enabled.description: Enable the constrained LLM fallback when lightweight guardian support cannot resolve the incident.

llm_mode.description: LLM operating mode. Supported values are off, fallback, and always.

llm_provider_order.description: Comma-separated provider order for LLM fallback. Supported values are gpt and claude.

llm_base_url.description: Legacy OpenAI-compatible base URL used for GPT fallback calls when llm_gpt_base_url is unset.

llm_model.description: Legacy GPT model name used when llm_gpt_model is unset.

llm_api_key.description: Legacy GPT API key used when llm_gpt_api_key is unset.

llm_gpt_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL used for GPT fallback calls.

llm_gpt_model.description: GPT model name used for constrained Heimdall fallback.

llm_gpt_api_key.description: API key used for GPT fallback calls.

llm_claude_base_url.description: Anthropic-compatible base URL used for Claude fallback calls.

llm_claude_model.description: Claude model name used for constrained Heimdall fallback.

llm_claude_api_key.description: API key used for Claude fallback calls.

llm_claude_version.description: Anthropic API version header used for Claude fallback calls.

llm_system_prompt.description: Optional extra system prompt appended to Heimdall's default constrained instructions.

llm_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout used for LLM fallback calls.

llm_temperature.description: Sampling temperature used for LLM fallback calls.

action_catalog.name: assess_ecosystem
action_catalog.description: Observe the ecosystem snapshot and return health findings with an overall health score.

action_catalog.name: recommend_improvements
action_catalog.description: Produce prioritized improvement recommendations from the observed ecosystem state.

action_catalog.name: triage_critical_error
action_catalog.description: Triage one critical ecosystem incident into a diagnosis and immediate response actions.

action_catalog.name: auto_remediate_critical
action_catalog.description: Prepare a machine-actionable remediation plan for one critical ecosystem incident.

action_catalog.name: optimize_cost
action_catalog.description: Inspect cost signals and right-size opportunities across the ecosystem.
